'''Genaire''' is a country in [[Atirha]]. It's [[twelve provinces and two territories]] extend from the [[Srandan Ocean]] to the [[Ipfehr Bay]], making it the [[List of countries and dependencies by area|twenty-first-largest country by total area]], with the [[longest coastline of any country]]. Its borders [[Gaeiya]] and [[Arbiya]] to the east, [[Raledria]] and [[New Misos]] to the southeast, and it has a maritime border with [[Mentdria]] to the west. The country is characterised by a wide range of both meteorological and geological regions. With a population of over [[List of countries and dependencies by population|15 million]], it has widely varying population densities, with the majority residing in its urban areas and [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|large areas being sparsely populated]]. Genaire's capital and largest city is [[Lishka]], and its next three largest metropolitan areas are [[Braniv]], [[Tarnu]], and [[Volzian]].

People [[first arrived]] in what is now Genaire only a few hundred years ago. Beginning in the 16th century, [[Taval|Tavalan]] and [[Emara|Emaran]] expeditions explored and later settled along the [[Ipfehr Bay]]. As a consequence of the [[First Treaty of Atirha]], [[Taval]] ceded nearly all of its trade outposts past the [[Sukiwa line]] in [[Airtha]] in 1434. In 1633, the [[eight provinces]] of [[Tel Blicni]] were assigned as [[higher colonies]] by the [[Emara|Emaran Government]]. This began an accretion of [[centralisation]] and [[migration]], resulting in the displacement of the [[original settler culture]] and a process of increasing autonomy from [[Emara]]. This increased sovereignty was highlighted by the transformation of the [[Genaire Trading Company]] in 1646 into the [[Genaire colony]], and culminated in the [[Genaire Act of 1704]], which severed the vestiges of legal dependence on the Emaran Government and [[unified]] the two [[colonies of Genaire]] and Tel Blicni into the Republic of Genaire.

Genaire is a [[wikipedia:Unitary_parliamentary_republic|Unitary parliamentary republic]]. The country's head of government is the [[High Minister]], who holds office by virtue of their ability to [[command the confidence]] of the elected [[National Assembly]] and is appointed by the [[Lainar of the People]], representing the provinces, though this is entirely ceremonial. It is highly ranked in international measurements of [[government transparency]], quality of life, economic competitiveness, [[innovation]], education and [[human rights.]] It is one of the world's [[most ethnically diverse and multicultural nations]], the product of large-scale [[wikipedia:Immigration|immigration]]. Genaire's long and complex relationship with [[New Misos]] has had a [[significant impact]] on its history, economy, and culture.

A developed country, Genaire has a [[List of countries by GDP (nominal) per capita|high nominal per capita]] income globally and its advanced economy ranks among the [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|larger in the world by nominal GDP,]] relying chiefly upon its abundant [[natural resources]] and well-developed [[wikipedia:International_trade|international trade]] networks. Recognised as a [[minor powe]]<nowiki/>r, Genaire's support for [[wikipedia:Multilateralism|multilateralism]] and [[wikipedia:Internationalism_(politics)|internationalism]] has been closely related to its foreign policies of [[peacekeeping]] and aid for developing countries. Genaire promotes its domestically shared values through participation in [[multiple international organisations and forums]].
